ops.title: Add typed detail union to SystemEvent; promote AttachmentEvent to TranscriptEvent
ops.description: SystemEvent gains `level` + always-set `detail` union (StopHookSummary | CompactBoundary | TurnDuration | ModelRefusalFallback | OtherSystemDetail(raw)) — closes the one lossy event kind. AttachmentEvent becomes a new TranscriptEvent member (kind "attachment") with typed hook payloads + QueuedCommand + OtherAttachment(raw). Breaking: EventKind/union growth → major version bump, isolated final commit.

ops.text: SystemEvent.detail always set; unknown subtypes land in OtherSystemDetail(raw) — no system record is lossy
AttachmentEvent in TranscriptEvent union, EventKind gains "attachment", notifications.delivered_text matches typed QueuedCommand, render.py TAGS/event_payload/haystack handle the new kind
Rust Entry::Attachment + SystemDetail enum mirror with full parity suites green
Changelog/commit flags the major version bump and the disappearance of OtherEvent(type=="attachment") matches
